messages:
maria_cs: Weekly health check for NovaRetail (acct NR-778) — heads up: notable error spike Fri 09:22–09:48 UTC. Quick topline: 5xx ~62% of errors, timeouts ~22%, rate limits ~16%. Listing top failing endpoints and sample counts below. This is impacting a few high-QPS routes so could affect renewal convo next week.

maria_cs: Top failing endpoints (aggregated Fri window):
```
/v1/generate           5xx -> 3,812 errors (48% of total)
/v1/embeddings        timeout -> 1,820 (23%)
/v1/chat/completions  rate_limited -> 1,430 (18%)
/v1/rerank            5xx -> 880 (11%)
```

maria_cs: Sample 5xx log for /v1/generate: `RuntimeError: model shard OOM while allocating 2.1GB` (x1,200) and intermittent `internal_server_error` traces. Timeouts show long tail at 10s+. Rate limits mostly from burst traffic on /v1/chat/completions (client-side retries causing thundering).

monitor-bot: alert: nova-retail-prod error_rate > 5% over 15m at 2026-03-19T09:24:00Z — alerted 09:25 UTC

raj_ops: I see cluster autoscaler flapped around 09:20 due to preemptible eviction, took ~3 nodes to spin up — might explain initial latency spike. There are also >30% CPU steal signals on gpux-7.

tyler_eng: Investigating model-serving logs now. Initial signal is repeated shard reloads which coincide with the OOMs. Possible regression from last quantization tweak rolled on 03/17.

zara_se: Customer scheduled an enablement call Monday 10am PT. They flagged "intermittent 500s during peak checkout flows" and asked for mitigation before renewal talk.

sophie_pm: Renewal touchpoint scheduled Tue — if errors persist they might push renewal to Q3. Need a mitigation plan to show during the call.

maria_cs: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) roll back 03/17 quantization tweak on dedicated pool for NovaRetail (canary), 2) enable fallback to smaller model for /v1/generate during high latency windows, 3) temporary rate-limit bump for their IP allowlist while we stabilize. Thoughts?

tyler_eng: On rollback — I can stage a canary rollback in dedicated pool and monitor. ETA 45m if ops approves. Will also add extra heap caps to prevent shard OOM.

raj_ops: Approving canary rollback. I can pre-warm two extra nodes and pin their autoscaler to avoid churn during the window.

zara_se: I'll tell the customer we have a mitigation plan and offer a brief status update Monday morning. Can we get a short one-pager for them?

maria_cs: I'll draft one-pager and include: what happened, immediate mitigations, expected timeline, and a post-mortem promise.

sophie_pm: Also capture any cost impact — they asked about spend variability. If we pre-warm nodes there will be a small delta; include that estimate.

tyler_eng: Noted — will include expected CPU/GPU delta numbers after autoscaler pin.

maria_cs: Action items: tyler -> rollback canary + OOM cap (ETA 45m). raj -> pre-warm nodes + confirm pin (ETA 20m). zara -> customer comms + Monday status. sophie -> update renewal risk doc. maria_cs -> one-pager (EOD).

raj_ops: on it.

tyler_eng: starting rollback now. will post logs.

zara_se: thanks, team. :thumbsup:

monitor-bot: incident-create draft: incident-nr-778-2026-03-19-09 

maria_cs: I'll follow up with a short summary once we see rollback metrics. If anything changes ping me directly.
